---
title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Grady Woodard"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County",
    fill = "Median income",
    caption = "Source: 2020 American Community Survey (U.S. Census Bureau)"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_001",
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
edu_state |>
  filter(variable != "B15003_001") |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    pct_bachelors = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_bachelors, y = reorder(NAME, pct_bachelors))) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = pct_bachelors)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1), guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = "Adults with bachelor's degree or higher",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "County Population and Median Age in California",
    x = "Population",
    y = "Median age"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
